entities.name: Spice Trade
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: The millennia-long global trade in spices — pepper, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, and mace — that drove exploration, colonization, and war from antiquity to the 18th century. Spices were worth more than gold by weight in medieval Europe. The quest for direct spice access motivated Portuguese, Spanish, Dutch, and English voyages of exploration and the creation of the first multinational corporations (VOC, EIC).
